description: agent-fabric's own GZCoord integration: a session in the control plane's working copy (the fabric-coordinator's, on this host) is on the same relay and channel as the agents it coordinates. The channel is the fleet's coordination channel, hosted from this workspace; until 2026-09-16 the runtime's built-in defaults supplied this and the fabric had no integration of its own — a fail-closed runtime needs one, or the coordinator's inbox drains nothing and its sends stop. Read by gzcoord-inbox when the working copy resolves to project agent-fabric; CLAUDE_BRIDGE_URL and GZCOORD_CHANNEL in the environment override it. No token_env_file: the coordinator's token is the relay's own (relay_runtime_dir/bridge-token) or its synced secrets.
